salmon.name: Endangered Chinook Salmon
captions: At Dekkas Rock on Shasta Lake, the Juvenile Salmonid Collection System (JSCS) pilot project tests the feasibility of collecting young salmon migrating from habitats upstream of Shasta Dam.

California Department of Water Resources Environmental Scientist Kevin Marr, left, and Environmental Science Associates’ Nolan Santala prepare to release juvenile salmon as part of the JSCS Pilot Project

Shad fish swim along the JSCS at Dekkas Rock at Shasta Lake in Lakehead, California, within Shasta County. This is a first step of the project in restoring endangered Chinook salmon to their historical spawning grounds.

delta.name: Lookout Slough Tidal Habitat
captions: An aerial view of the Lookout Slough Tidal Habitat Restoration and Flood Improvement Project in Solano County.a multi-benefit effort to restore tidal wetlands, create habitat for Delta Smelt and other fish, increase flood capacity in the Yolo Bypass, and reduce flood risk in the Sacramento area. Features include a 25-foot setback levee, 20 miles of tidal channels, and native habitat restoration.

drinkingwater.name: East Porterville Water Supply
captions: In 2016, many East Porterville residents were left without a reliable water supply after wells ran dry during California’s five-year drought. To address this, engineers from the California Department of Water Resources designed a system to deliver water from the City of Porterville to 1,800 homes in East Porterville.
Sequoia Community Corps workers install pipeline connections from the main line to individual homes.
From left, Leonicio Ramirez and his daughter Tania Ramirez are the first East Porterville residents to receive water through the new distribution system.

climate.name: Emergency Drought Salinity Barrier
captions: The completed Emergency Drought Salinity Barrier on the West False River near Oakley, in the Sacramento–San Joaquin Delta, Contra Costa County. The 750-foot-wide rock barrier helps block the tidal push of saltwater from San Francisco Bay into the central Delta.
